subject: Re: Encord | Questions to support commercial proposal
text:
Hi James,

It was great to get a sense of where Encord is headed as it relates to
other sensor visualisation.

*1. What is the expected number of Encord users?*

We will start on the 5. But it will potentially grow quickly. Can you
provide the costs as it relates to different user licenses? Start with 5,
then 20, then 50, then 100.

*2. What are your current data file volumes split by modality? For context
- one image with three corresponding sensor files would be four files, so
it will be helpful to understand both totals and splits. This also applies
to sampled frames in videos - happy to talk through in another call if any
questions on this. *

~300 KiB per image and ~600 KiB per point cloud. For now, we could go up to
1B files total (across both types). It would be good to get a range of
options here too.

*3. We’re assuming that you’ll be visualising using your own pre-computed
embeddings, but do let us know if you'd want to use our embeddings, as this
changes cost considerations*

We will use our own embeddings.

Because there are a lot of unknowns, especially with how point clouds will
be visualised, can you share the milestones that you are working towards as
it relates to what Rad showed on Friday?

Also, can you share the following information:

   1. What data formates do you support (we would prefer Apache
   Arrow-formats)?
   2. What is the schema that we need to create for the data to flow into
   the Encord ecosystem? The more specific the better.
   3. Instead of only sharing access to similar datasets in the UI, are we
   able to test out the integration with our own data before purchase?

Thank you.

Cheers,
Rick
